title: CONVERGENCE FIELD
claim: Local-first workbench for testing unequal projections over one captured object: NOW/LENS/RUN/PROOF/ATLAS share stable local object state and RETURN receipts without claiming that any renderer is canon.
observed_surface: CAPTURE requires explicit source text for new user objects
NOW / LENS / RUN / PROOF / ATLAS operate over the same local state
PLAIN ↔ FIELD ablation uses identical stored state
RETURN receipts carry source hash, delta, residue, next re-entry and observed/user-rated metrics
export/import preserves objects and receipts by stable local ID
provenance_boundary: Fresh sessions now boot with sourceClass=DEMO and an explicit synthetic fixture. DEMO is not user material, canon or evidence.
known_limits: LocalStorage is local browser state, not shared durable canon.
Several renderers are experimental projections and have no independent empirical validation.
Elapsed/counter metrics are observations; ratings are explicitly subjective.
Source hash is lightweight local identity support, not cryptographic integrity.
No renderer or stored object gains FIELD/CURRENT/MIGRATION authority by existing here.
